text:
Nora Velasquez: hi everyone! Nora here, product design, first day. Two quick asks: 1) where's the short cheat-sheet for getting API creds and running a local mock service? 2) whats the 'two truths and a weird skill' tradition you all do? Also — fun fact: I can play the didgeridoo badly.

Jamie Lin: welcome @Nora Velasquez :tada: For creds, the one-pager is pinned in #devex and also in the onboarding doc in the wiki. Minimal flow: 1) 1Password invite -> request team/project entry, 2) request sandbox key (Devex Bot), 3) run the mock server docker image below.

Devex Bot: To spin up the local mock quickly:

```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/redwood/mock-playground:stable
# then: http://localhost:8080/docs
```

Ben Carter: hi Nora! On the tradition: during the first-week intro call we each say two truths + one weird skill. No pressure  but people love hearing about travel or hidden hobbies.

Lena Ortiz: welcome! If you need a fast laptop config while IT ships yours, reply "loaner" and indicate timezone. Also theres a short "who to ask" list in the onboarding thread pinned here: infra -> @Ben Carter, IT -> @Jamie Lin, Benefits -> @Sabrina (cc).

IT Support Bot: Asset ASSET-9918 assigned to Nora Velasquez. ETA 1 business day for provisioning. Reply "loaner" to request interim device.

Nora Velasquez: thanks all  I requested the sandbox key and tried the docker mock  works great. Loaner please (PST). Also Ill prepare my two truths for the intro call: climbed Elbrus, speaks 3 languages, weird skill = can thread a needle blindfolded. Looking forward to meeting everyone!
